supported_primitives: Descriptive horizontal walking-speed observations on one station platform only.
exclusions: No three-dimensional geometry, stair, escalator, lift, gate, body-dimension, route-choice, information, accessibility, evacuation, or whole-facility claim is supported by this catalog.
split_rationale: The publisher partitions the recording into disjoint ten-day files. Days 01–30 are calibration and days 31–60 are held out, preventing row-level and trajectory-level leakage between the roles. The temporal partition remains a single-site, single-measurement-system split rather than external validation.
